name: Salient Subset Construction via Cumulative Histograms
definition: A technique to build representative voxel subsets ($\Gamma$ and $\Lambda$) by thresholding volume quantities using cumulative histograms, allowing control over the percentage of voxels included.
summary: Salient Subset Construction via Cumulative Histograms selects representative sparse voxel subsets by thresholding scalar quantities using cumulative histograms, distinguishing itself from sibling methods by relying on histogram-based thresholding rather than direct eigenvalue magnitude comparison.
